# /crav1-environment-read

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a named host](../../from-environment.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-environment-read/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Read the host the user named.

## Runs when

The user names the host. Called by the user.

This is one of the seven starter options. Asking for startup options names it and does not run it.

## Reads

In short: Non-prod resources on that host.

Reads the host the user named, non-prod resources on that host, prod-only resources for shape and connections when the user says yes, and `docs/environments/marks.md` when it exists. After that read, optional SQL metadata and storage structure only when the user says yes.

## Writes

In short: Confirmed lines appended to `docs/environments/marks.md`; confirmed sections go to their owners through [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md), [`/crav1-repos-to-spec`](crav1-repos-to-spec.md), or [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md).

Writes only confirmed lines appended to `docs/environments/marks.md`.

## Does not

Leaves `docs/system`, `docs/architecture/spec.md`, feature specs, `docs/architecture/left-out.md`, and application code alone.

Limits and exceptions: does not guess the host. Naming production, prod, or live stops. One pass covers every non-prod environment. Pre-prod, shared-with-prod, and prod-only stay shape and connections until one yes. A no leaves prod-only in Skipped. Look-inside never opens production. A database with no clear environment is asked before it is opened. Missing access stops that look-inside. Never rows, blobs, or production data. Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud each have a reader. Any other host stops with no reader. A fact is seen in that environment. A prod-only line says `prod only`. A link only when the environment shows the connection. Does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. Names [`/crav1-pipeline-environments`](crav1-pipeline-environments.md) and does not run it. After `marks.md` lines are added, it asks once whether to run [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md) and does not run that refresh from the question.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md), [`/crav1-repos-to-spec`](crav1-repos-to-spec.md), and [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md) for the append only after that section is confirmed.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Start. Starter option: yes. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.13.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).
